updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Entra Global Secure Access Integration Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection at the network layer across browsers, apps, and APIs, including generative AI platforms. This integration allows organizations to detect risky user activity and prevent sensitive data exfiltration to untrusted cloud applications in real time.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77903: Microsoft Dataverse Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Dataverse allows unauthorized attackers to spoof identities and elevate privileges over the network. Organizations using Dataverse for identity-related workloads should apply security updates immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69843: Microsoft Fabric Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability via spoofing in Microsoft Fabric enables unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. This affects organizations leveraging Fabric for governance and data access control.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85889: Azure AI Foundry Missing Authentication for Critical Function
updates.summary: Azure AI Foundry contains a missing authentication vulnerability for critical functions, allowing unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations using AI Foundry must apply patches to prevent unauthorized access.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Diagnostics Access Expanded to Additional Admin Roles
updates.summary: Diagnostic capabilities in Purview are now accessible to Compliance Administrators, Security Administrators, and Organization Management roles, moving beyond Global Admin-only access. This expands role-based permissions and enables better delegation of troubleshooting responsibilities.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Enhanced Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Conditional Access for managed apps in Edge for Business, supporting expanded conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and activity explorer visibility. This simplifies policy configuration while extending data protection across enterprise applications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP now extends browser-based inline protection to a broader set of unmanaged generative AI and SaaS applications in Edge for Business. Admins can leverage existing DLP policies to detect and prevent sensitive data sharing through these applications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: User-Based Alert Aggregation
updates.summary: Purview DLP now aggregates related alerts by common entities or users even when multiple rules match, reducing alert noise and simplifying incident investigation. This improves security operations efficiency by consolidating related violation events into single alert objects.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations Integration
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now enables launching pre-scoped Data Security Investigations directly from IRM cases, allowing deeper analysis of user content and post-incident data impact. This enhances insider threat investigation workflows by integrating two critical Purview capabilities.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Support for Collection Policies
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now supports Purview collection policies, allowing admins to scope sensitive information type classification and activities for specific users. This enables more granular and efficient detection of insider risks across the organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Sensitivity Labels Now Available in Engage
updates.summary: Organizations can now apply Information Protection sensitivity labels in Microsoft Engage communities, enabling classification and protection of sensitive data through privacy and external user access controls. Admins can configure label publishing policies to control which users and groups can apply labels.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: Full Target Domain Path Display in Activity Explorer
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now displays the complete path of target domains in Activity Explorer instead of just the domain name, improving visibility and investigation accuracy. This enhancement helps admins track and analyze data movement across endpoints more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: SharePoint file archiving is now integrated into Purview Data Lifecycle Management, allowing admins to configure retention policies that archive inactive content to low-cost storage. This extends governance across the full content lifecycle while maintaining discoverability and compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Insights and Policy Recommendations for Sensitive M365 Data
updates.summary: Purview DLM now provides visibility and policy recommendations for sensitive data across OneDrive and SharePoint, helping organizations improve their data security and compliance posture. Admins can use these insights to automatically recommend retention policies tailored to sensitive content.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69865: Microsoft Container Registry Authorization Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Microsoft Container Registry contains an authorization bypass vulnerability through user-controlled keys that allows privilege elevation over the network. Organizations should apply security updates to prevent unauthorized access to container infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-68791: Azure Machine Learning Incorrect Authorization Information Disclosure
updates.summary: Azure Machine Learning contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability allowing unauthorized information disclosure over the network. This may expose sensitive model data or training information to unauthorized users.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85878: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Improper Authorization Privilege Escalation
updates.summary: Azure Database for PostgreSQL contains an improper authorization vulnerability allowing authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Database administrators should apply patches to restrict privilege escalation paths.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Protection for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Purview DLP now supports data protection policies for non-Microsoft SaaS applications such as Box and Google Workspace, using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends classification and DLP controls beyond the Microsoft 365 ecosystem to hybrid cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention Hold and Site Deletion Improvements
updates.summary: Purview DLM now provides enhanced capabilities for managing retention holds on inactive mailboxes and unlicensed OneDrive sites via PowerShell, including automatic delay hold application and Priority Cleanup for permanent file deletion. These improvements streamline hold management and site lifecycle operations.
